judgments.reasoning_cat1: The recitals define "Project" in sweeping terms and use hedged figures ("approximately" US$530,000,000 / US$713,000,000 / US$1,097,000,000) that have no fixed boundary. The scope of the defined "Project" and "Project Lenders" is left open enough that a court could be asked what falls inside it.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The recital says term loan lenders "shall provide" approximately US$530,000,000 while the operative definition of "Total Commitment" fixes US$250,000,000 (capped at US$530,000,000 only on accession), and it treats the "Letter of Credit Facility" as a separate facility though Section 2.06(a) makes LC capacity consume the same Unused Commitment. Section 2.08(b) also uses the recital's US$1,097,000,000 estimate as an operative trigger.
